summary:
Our project, "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer," is an interactive space-learning application designed to help students understand astronaut activities and space exploration.

The application provides virtual astronaut training through five missions: Earth, Moon, Mars, International Space Station (ISS), and Emergency Missions.

Students can explore planets, learn about space science, understand planetary rover operations, and participate in interactive quizzes and simulated mission challenges.

The rover operations module introduces four important activities: Rover Navigation, Terrain Analysis, Scientific Data Collection, and Communication and Control.

Our platform also includes age-based learning levels, points, badges, and mission achievements to make learning more engaging.

We aim to use NASA educational resources and real planetary mission information to improve scientific understanding.

Our vision is to transform traditional space education into an interactive learning experience and encourage students to develop scientific curiosity, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
details:
We used Lovable AI and Google Gemini to develop our Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer application.

Lovable AI helped us design and develop the web application, including its user interface and interactive features.

Google Gemini helped us generate ideas, understand space science concepts, organize educational content, and improve our project features.

These AI tools supported our development process and helped us build an interactive space-learning experience for students.

Our team reviewed the content, made project decisions, and worked on the final application.
